name: Documenso v2 Document Signing
description: Send and sign PDFs with audit trails. Self-hosted DocuSign alternative.

PORT.description: Port the Documenso server listens on; Railway routes traffic and healthchecks here.

NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL.description: Public URL (links in e-mails, signing pages, CSRF origin). Change it when you add a custom domain.

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sessions and CSRF cookies. Changing it signs everyone out.

NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Primary key (min. 32 characters) for encrypted fields such as 2FA secrets and API tokens. Never change it after first boot.

NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_SECONDARY_KEY.description: Secondary encryption key (min. 32 characters). Never change it after first boot.

NEXT_PRIVATE_DIRECT_DATABASE_URL.description: Direct connection used by Prisma migrations (same as above without a pooler).

NEXT_PRIVATE_JOBS_PROVIDER.description: Background jobs (e-mails, sealing, webhooks, reminders) on BullMQ + Redis, upstream's recommended self-hosted production provider.

NEXT_PRIVATE_REDIS_URL.description: Redis for the BullMQ job queue. family=0 lets ioredis use IPv4 or IPv6 on the private network.

NEXT_PRIVATE_REDIS_PREFIX.description: Key prefix for the job queues.

NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_TRANSPORT.description: Sign with a local .p12 certificate (created on the volume at first boot).

NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_PASSPHRASE.description: Passphrase protecting the signing certificate. The certificate on the volume only opens with this value: do not change it after first boot.

NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_LOCAL_FILE_PATH.description: Certificate path on the volume. Replace the file (or set NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_LOCAL_FILE_CONTENTS to a base64 .p12) to use a CA-issued certificate.

SIGNING_CERT_COMMON_NAME.description: Common name of the self-signed certificate created at first boot (shown in PDF signature panels).

SIGNING_CERT_ORGANIZATION.description: Organization name in the self-signed certificate. Set your company name before the first deploy.

SIGNING_CERT_DAYS.description: Validity of the self-signed certificate in days.

NEXT_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_TRANSPORT.description: Store documents in the Railway Bucket (s3). Set to database to keep them in Postgres instead.

NEXT_PRIVATE_UPLOAD_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted URLs; set true only for a legacy bucket that requires path-style.

NEXT_PUBLIC_DOCUMENT_SIZE_UPLOAD_LIMIT.description: Maximum document upload size in MB.

NEXT_PRIVATE_DOCUMENT_CONVERSION_URL.description: Gotenberg service that converts uploaded .docx files to PDF (private network).

NEXT_PRIVATE_DOCUMENT_CONVERSION_USERNAM.description: Shared with Gotenberg: references its basic-auth user (edit it there).

NEXT_PRIVATE_DOCUMENT_CONVERSION_PASSWOR.description: Shared with Gotenberg: references its basic-auth password (edit it there).

NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_TRANSPORT.description: E-mail transport. Empty = automatic: resend when NEXT_PRIVATE_RESEND_API_KEY is set, otherwise smtp-auth. Also accepts smtp-api and mailchannels.

NEXT_PRIVATE_RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key (HTTP e-mail API, works on every Railway plan). Recommended way to send signing requests.

NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS.description: Sender address, e.g. sign@yourcompany.com (must be a domain verified with your e-mail provider).

NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP host (outbound SMTP needs Railway Pro). Optional.

NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_SECURE.description: Set true for implicit TLS (port 465). Optional.

NEXT_PUBLIC_DISABLE_SIGNUP.description: Set true to disable all new sign-ups once your team is in (the admin account is created by the bootstrap).

NEXT_PRIVATE_ALLOWED_SIGNUP_DOMAINS.description: Comma-separated e-mail domains allowed to sign up, e.g. yourcompany.com. Empty = any domain.

NEXT_PRIVATE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Google OAuth client ID for 'Sign in with Google'.

DOCUMENSO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY.description: Opt out of Documenso's anonymous instance telemetry (version and installation ID). Set false to share it.

DOCUMENSO_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: E-mail of the first administrator. The template creates this account (verified, ADMIN role) on first boot so you can sign in without an e-mail provider.

DOCUMENSO_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the first administrator (used once at creation; change it in your profile afterwards).

DOCUMENSO_ADMIN_NAME.description: Display name of the first administrator.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized.

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down.

REDISHOST.description: Private network hostname of the Redis service, only resolvable from services in the same environment.

REDIS_URL.description: Connection string for connecting to Redis using the private network.

REDISPASSWORD.description: Alias of REDIS_PASSWORD for clients that expect the unseparated name.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Randomly generated password for authenticating with Redis.

PORT.description: Port Gotenberg listens on ([::], dual-stack); used for the healthcheck.

GOTENBERG_API_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME.description: Basic-auth user Documenso uses for conversions.

GOTENBERG_API_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Basic-auth password Documenso uses for conversions.
